info.title: Trello API - baton-trello connector surface
info.description:
This document describes ONLY the subset of the Trello REST API that the baton-trello connector (pkg/client/client.go) calls. It is not a full description of Trello's API. Scope, shapes, and evidence are recorded per operation in the connector repository's PR description.

Auth: every request appends `key` (API key) and `token` (API token) as query parameters (see `authorizeEndpointUrl` in pkg/client/client.go). The connector does not use Trello's OAuth1 header flow.

Base URL: defaults to https://api.trello.com/1 and can be overridden by the connector's `base-url` config field (CLI flag `--base-url`, mapstructure key `base-url`), which is hidden/CLI-only and intended for pointing the connector at a mock server in tests.

servers.description: Default Trello API base URL (pkg/client/client.go `domain` constant). Overridable via the connector's `base-url` config field (pkg/config/config.go `BaseURLField`, CLI flag --base-url).

ApiKeyAuth.name: key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Trello API key. Appended to every request as `?key=...` by `authorizeEndpointUrl` (pkg/client/client.go). Sourced from the connector's `api-key` config field.

ApiTokenAuth.name: token
ApiTokenAuth.description: Trello API token. Appended to every request as `&token=...` by `authorizeEndpointUrl` (pkg/client/client.go). Sourced from the connector's `api-token` config field. Trello also supports an OAuth1 `Authorization` header flow, which this connector does not use.

TrelloId.description: Trello object id. Per vendor docs this is normally a 24-character hex Mongo-style id (e.g. `5abbe4b7ddc1b351ef961414`); this repo's test fixtures use UUID-like placeholder strings instead, so no `pattern` is enforced here.

Member.description: Trello member (user) object, as returned by GET /organizations/{id}/members and GET /members/{id}. Only the properties the connector's `client.User` struct declares (pkg/client/model.go) are modeled; Trello's real Member object has many more fields (bio, email, avatarUrl, prefs, ...) that this connector never reads.

fullName.description: Member's display name. Go field: User.Name (json:"fullName").

username.description: Member's Trello username. Go field: User.Username.

memberType.description: Account-state classification of the Member resource itself (vendor docs: developer.atlassian.com Member schema). NOTE: this is a different concept from the membership-role `memberType` (admin/normal/observer) returned by the /memberships endpoints below -- the connector binds both into the same Go struct field (`client.User.MemberType`), so do not conflate the two.

Membership.description: Trello membership record, as returned by GET /organizations/{id}/memberships, GET /boards/{id}/memberships, and embedded in Board.memberships. Only the properties `client.User` declares are modeled (pkg/client/model.go); the real API also returns `unconfirmed` and `deactivated` booleans (confirmed in test/mockResponses/boardsMock.json) which the connector never reads and are therefore omitted here.

id.description: Membership record id (NOT the member's id). Go field: User.ID (json:"id") when decoding a membership list -- note this struct field is reused for two different meanings depending on the endpoint; see Membership vs Member schema descriptions.

idMember.description: The member's own id. Go field: User.MemberID (json:"idMember").

memberType.description: Membership role. Confirmed values from test/mockResponses/boardsMock.json: `admin`, `normal`. The organization entitlements builder (pkg/connector/organizations.go `memberTypes` var) additionally treats `observer` as a valid organization-level role, but that third value is not confirmed by a fixture or by Trello's published OpenAPI document (its `Memberships` schema is a near-empty stub listing only `id`) -- `observer` is recorded here as client-code-only evidence, not vendor-doc-proven. No enum is declared on this property for that reason.

Organization.description: Trello organization (Workspace) object, as returned by GET /organizations/{id}. Only the properties `client.Organization` declares are modeled (pkg/client/model.go). Trello's published OpenAPI document (swagger.v3.json) has an incomplete schema for this resource -- it omits `desc`, `descData`, `website`, `teamType`, `logoHash`, `logoUrl`, `products`, and `powerUps` entirely, and lists `premiumFeatures` where this connector (and the recorded fixture) show `products`/`powerUps` instead. For those properties this spec relies on test/mockResponses/organizationMock.json (a recorded response) plus the Go struct tags, not the vendor spec.

desc.description: Fixture-confirmed only (vendor schema omits this field); empty string in the recorded fixture.

descData.description: Fixture-confirmed only. Go models this as `struct { Emoji struct{} }`; shape of `emoji` beyond an empty object is unproven.

emoji.description: Unproven shape; empty object in the recorded fixture and in the Go zero value.

website.description: Fixture-confirmed only; null in the recorded fixture.

teamType.description: Fixture-confirmed only; null in the recorded fixture.

logoHash.description: Fixture-confirmed only; null in the recorded fixture.

logoUrl.description: Fixture-confirmed only; null in the recorded fixture.

offering.description: Vendor-confirmed (example values include `trello.business_class`, `trello.enterprise`); not modeled as a closed enum.

products.description: Fixture-confirmed only (`[110]`); not present in the vendor's generated schema.

powerUps.description: Fixture-confirmed only (`[110]`); not present in the vendor's generated schema.

BoardPrefs.description: Board preferences object (`prefs`). Only properties `client.Preferences` declares are modeled (pkg/client/model.go).

comments.description: Vendor schema declares this as a plain string with no enum; connector logic (pkg/connector/boards.go `evaluateMembership`) only special-cases the literal value `members`.

showCompleteStatus.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

cardCounts.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

hiddenPluginBoardButtons.description: Client code only; Go models this as `[]interface{}`, shape unproven.

switcherViews.description: Client code only; not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

background.description: Vendor schema types this as a TrelloId reference (background image/color id).

backgroundColor.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

backgroundDarkColor.description: Client code only; Go models this as `interface{}`, shape unproven (can include null). No `type` is constrained.

backgroundImage.description: Vendor-confirmed as a string; Go models it as `interface{}` because it can also be null.

backgroundDarkImage.description: Client code only; Go models this as `interface{}`, shape unproven (can include null). No `type` is constrained.

backgroundImageScaled.description: Vendor schema says array of ImageDescriptor objects; Go models it as `interface{}` and the connector never reads it, so item shape is unproven here.

backgroundBrightness.description: Vendor-confirmed (example value `dark`); no enum declared by the vendor.

sharedSourceUrl.description: Client code only; Go models this as `interface{}`, shape unproven (can include null). No `type` is constrained.

LabelNames.description: Custom label-color name mapping (`labelNames`). Only properties `client.Board.LabelNames` declares are modeled (pkg/client/model.go). Trello's published OpenAPI document only confirms the 10 base colors; the `_dark`/`_light` variants are client-code-only evidence.

green_dark.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

yellow_dark.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

orange_dark.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

lime_dark.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

pink_dark.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

black_dark.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

yellow_light.description: Client code only -- not present in Trello's published OpenAPI document.

Board.description: Trello board object. Only properties `client.Board` declares are modeled (pkg/client/model.go). This schema is shared by GET /organizations/{id}/boards and GET /boards/{id}, but the two operations return different subsets of it in practice -- see each operation's description.

descData.description: Unproven shape: Go models this as `interface{}`. Fixtures show both `null` and an object; vendor schema says `string`. No `type` is constrained here since the real shape varies; treat as free-form.

idEnterprise.description: Go models this as `interface{}`; always `null` in recorded fixtures.

memberships.description: Only populated when the request's `fields` parameter includes `memberships` (Trello `BoardFields` enum). GET /organizations/{id}/boards defaults `fields` to `all`, which includes it (confirmed in test/mockResponses/boardsMock.json). GET /boards/{id} defaults `fields` to a fixed list that does NOT include `memberships`, and this connector never overrides that default, so this property is normally absent on the GET /boards/{id} response the connector actually receives -- see GetBoardDetails, which only reads `board.Preferences` from that call.

get.description: Called by TrelloClient.GetOrganizationDetail (pkg/client/client.go:173), in turn called once per configured organization id by ListOrganizations (pkg/client/client.go:104), which backs the organization resource's List(). No query parameters are sent beyond auth.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Organization id or name, from the connector's `organizations` config field.

get.description: Called by TrelloClient.ListBoards (pkg/client/client.go:125), once per configured organization id, backing the board resource's List(). No query parameters are sent by the connector; Trello defaults `filter` to `all` and `fields` to `all`, and the `all` fields set includes `memberships` (Trello `BoardFields` enum), which is why each board in the recorded fixture (test/mockResponses/boardsMock.json) carries a `memberships` array.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Not sent by the connector. Documented here because it gates which boards Trello returns; Trello's default (`all`) is relied on implicitly.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Not sent by the connector. Documented here because Trello's default (`all`) is what causes `memberships` to be included on each returned board; see Board.memberships.

get.description: Called by TrelloClient.ListUsers (pkg/client/client.go:82), once per configured organization id, backing the user resource's List(). Trello's API reference does not document any query parameters for this endpoint, and the connector sends none beyond auth.

Called by TrelloClient.ListMembershipsByOrg (pkg/client/client.go:187), then for each returned membership the connector calls GET /members/{id} (TrelloClient.GetMemberDetails) to fill in `fullName`/`username`. Backs the organization resource's Grants(). No query parameters are sent by the connector; Trello defaults `filter` to `all` and `member` to `false` (so member profile fields are not inlined, matching why this connector makes the follow-up GET /members/{id} call).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Not sent by the connector; Trello's default (`all`) is relied on implicitly.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: Not sent by the connector; Trello's default (`false`) means member profile fields are not inlined on each membership, which is why the connector makes a separate GET /members/{id} call per membership.

get.description: Called by TrelloClient.GetBoardDetails (pkg/client/client.go:150), once per board, from the board resource's Entitlements() and Grants() (only `board.Preferences` is read from the result). No query parameters are sent by the connector; Trello's documented default for `fields` on this endpoint is the fixed list `name,desc,descData,closed,idOrganization,pinned,url,shortUrl,prefs,labelNames` (NOT `all`), so `idEnterprise` and `memberships` are normally absent from this particular response even though they appear on the Board schema used elsewhere.

Called by TrelloClient.ListMembershipsByBoard (pkg/client/client.go:164), then for each returned membership the connector calls GET /members/{id} (TrelloClient.GetMemberDetails) to fill in `fullName`/`username`. Backs the board resource's Grants(). No query parameters are sent by the connector. NOTE: Trello's published OpenAPI document (swagger.v3.json) models this operation's 200 response as a single Memberships object rather than an array, which is inconsistent with the sibling /organizations/{id}/memberships array response and with this connector's client code (`listMembershipsByResource` decodes into `[]User`). This spec models the response as an array on that client-code evidence; treat the vendor spec's singular shape here as unreliable.

Called by TrelloClient.GetMemberDetails (pkg/client/client.go:218), once per membership record returned by the board/organization memberships endpoints above, to resolve `fullName`/`username` for a member id. The caller overwrites the decoded `memberType` with the membership-role value it already had (see `listMembershipsByResource`), so this endpoint's own `memberType` value is decoded but not relied upon. No query parameters are sent by the connector; Trello defaults `fields` to `all` for this endpoint, so the full Member object is returned.
